Both leaders agreed to separate historical issues from trade and security discussions.

A warning that the following report contains distressing images.

Three consecutive failed rainy seasons have left more than 330,000 people in northern Kenya facing a catastrophic drought. 
The government has placed Mandera County in the “alarm” stage, declaring a drought emergency. Most of the people in Mandera County depend on the land to survive. 

Al Jazeera’s Haru Mutasa went to northern Kenya to meet some of them.

US President Trump has announced a 25% tariff on countries doing business with Iran.

Tariff wars and trade wars have no ‌winners, and coercion and pressure cannot solve problems.
China ⁠firmly opposes any illicit unilateral sanctions and long-arm jurisdiction and will ‌take all necessary measures to safeguard its legitimate rights and ‍interests."

Al Jazeera's Katrina Yu has more from Beijing, China.

Iran's foreign minister says the country is prepared for confrontation but is also leaving the door open for talks with the US.
In an exclusive interview with Al Jazeera, Abbas Araghchi said Tehran is prepared for all options as unrest in the country enters a third week.
Araghchi also confirmed that he is in contact with US special envoy Steve Witkoff, but that Iran won't negotiate while being threatened.  

Trita Parsi is the executive vice president of the Quincy Institute for Responsible Statecraft.
He says US diplomacy will struggle if it focuses only on Iran's nuclear program.
